editor.premise: A road-trip day turns a lakeside morning into an island excursion, explored by ferry, bicycle, scenic stops, and food breaks.

captions.note: Centered opening titles give way to brief speech emphases, labels, and comic corrections; words appear near relevant subjects rather than in fixed subtitle rows.

editor.notes: Use short travel fragments to skip logistics, then give views and observations longer holds. Alternate lens-facing explanation with its visual evidence. Keep music in bounded montage passages rather than under every conversation.
